data.title: Accessible Goa: 3-Day Wheelchair-Friendly Trip from Pune for Priya
data.summary: This 3-day itinerary from Pune to Goa is designed for Priya, who uses a manual wheelchair and portable ramp. The plan focuses on likely step-free travel, accessible beaches, and popular restaurants. Accessibility details must be checked directly with each venue before booking.

traveler.notes: Budget is 30,000 INR. Priya uses a manual wheelchair and portable ramp. She prefers minimal transfers and rest breaks. Emergency contact: Aman (brother) +91 98xxxxxx01.

days.title: Travel from Pune to Goa & Beachside Relaxation

items.name: Flight: Pune to Goa (Goa International Airport)
items.note: Book direct flight with airline assistance; request aisle seat near the front and early boarding. Check airline wheelchair policy and pre-book assistance. Source: https://www.goair.in/plan-my-trip/special-assistance

items.name: Pre-booked accessible taxi to hotel
items.note: Arrange for a taxi with space for wheelchair and ramp. Contact local operators like Goa Miles and confirm step-free access.

items.name: Check-in: Taj Holiday Village Resort & Spa
items.note: Request accessible room with step-free entry and accessible bathroom. Confirm ramp/lift availability. Source: https://www.tajhotels.com/en-in/taj/taj-holiday-village-goa/

items.name: Candolim Beach (beach promenade and shacks)
items.note: Visit the promenade and accessible beach shacks. Use portable ramp if needed. Confirm step-free access with shacks. Source: https://www.tripadvisor.in/Attraction_Review-g297605-d1204477-Reviews-Candolim_Beach-Candolim_Bardez_North_Goa_District_Goa.html

days.title: Explore North Goa: Beach, Fort, and Local Cuisine

items.name: Breakfast at hotel restaurant
items.note: Request table with easy wheelchair access. Confirm step-free entry.

items.name: Aguada Fort (outer ramparts and viewpoint)
items.note: Visit outer areas with flat paths. Some areas may have uneven surfaces; portable ramp may help. Confirm access with site. Source: https://www.goatourism.gov.in/destinations/forts/aguada-fort

items.name: Lunch at Fisherman's Wharf (Candolim)
items.note: Popular Goan cuisine. Request accessible seating and confirm step-free entry. Source: https://www.thefishermanswharf.in/

items.name: Calangute Beach (promenade area)
items.note: Stroll along the promenade and visit beachside cafes. Use portable ramp as needed. Confirm step-free access with venues.

days.title: Souvenir Shopping and Return to Pune

items.name: Mapusa Market (main entrance and ground floor)
items.note: Explore ground floor stalls for souvenirs. Avoid crowded times. Confirm step-free entry with market management. Source: https://www.goatourism.gov.in/destinations/markets/mapusa-market

items.name: Lunch at hotel or nearby accessible restaurant
items.note: Choose a restaurant with step-free access and accessible restrooms.

items.name: Accessible taxi to Goa International Airport
items.note: Pre-book taxi with space for wheelchair and ramp.

items.name: Flight: Goa to Pune (Goa International Airport)
items.note: Request airline assistance for boarding and deplaning. Confirm seat preference and early boarding.

access.summary: Goa International Airport provides step-free access with ramps and lifts, accessible restrooms, wheelchair assistance, and accessible parking. Braille signage is available, but information about hearing loops, quiet spaces, and accessible rooms is not specified.

draft.subject: Accessibility Information Request for Goa International Airport
draft.body: Hello, I am planning to travel through Goa International Airport and use a wheelchair. Could you please confirm: (1) Is the main entrance and all passenger areas step-free? (2) Are accessible restrooms available throughout the terminal? (3) Is there an accessible room or quiet space for resting if needed? (4) Can staff provide assistance on arrival if requested in advance? Thank you very much for your help.

access.summary: The resort is generally described as wheelchair accessible and provides Braille signage and assistive listening devices. However, details about step-free access, ramps, elevators, accessible restrooms, and accessible rooms are not specified and should be confirmed directly with the venue.

sources.title: Taj Holiday Village Resort & Spa Review: What To REALLY Expect If You Stay | Oyster.com
Taj Holiday Village Resort & Spa, Candolim: Room, Prices & Reviews | Travelocity

draft.subject: Accessibility Information Request – Taj Holiday Village Resort & Spa, Goa
draft.body: Hello, I am planning a visit and use a wheelchair. Could you please confirm: 1) Is the main entrance and all key areas (reception, dining, pool) step-free or ramped? 2) Do you have accessible rooms with step-free showers and grab bars? 3) Are there accessible restrooms in public areas? 4) Is there an elevator or step-free access to all guest rooms? 5) Do you have accessible parking spaces near the entrance? Thank you very much for your help.

access.summary: Candolim Beach offers step-free access with a permanent wooden ramp to the shoreline and has accessible restrooms. Wheelchair-accessible rooms are available at nearby hotels, and assistance services like accessible taxis have been introduced, but details on accessible parking and other features are unclear.

access.summary: Aguada Fort is not fully accessible for wheelchair users, as there are no step-free routes, ramps, or accessible restrooms. Parking is available near the entrance, and service animals are permitted, but uneven pathways and lack of lifts may limit access to some areas.

data.summary: The estimated cost of 33,000 INR is slightly above budget, mainly due to higher accessible hotel and taxi costs, but ensures step-free comfort and convenience. Spending more on accessible transport and accommodation is worth it for Priya’s safety and enjoyment, while airport wheelchair services remain free.

items.subject: Request for Wheelchair Assistance and Accessible Seating: Pune-Goa Flights
items.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

My name is Priya. I have booked flights from Pune to Goa and back. I use a manual wheelchair and will be traveling with a portable ramp. I kindly request wheelchair assistance at both Pune and Goa airports, early boarding, and an aisle seat near the front of the aircraft for both flights. Please confirm these arrangements in writing. My emergency contact is Aman (+91 98xxxxxx01).

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Priya

Kindly confirm these details in writing.

Thank you very much.

Best regards,
Priya

turns.user: The lift at my hotel is broken and my room is on the 4th floor. What now?

data.issue: Hotel lift is broken and Priya's room is on the 4th floor, making it inaccessible for her wheelchair.

options.title: Request an Accessible Ground Floor Room
options.detail: Ask the hotel staff to move Priya to a ground floor room or a room on a floor that can be reached without using the lift. This is the safest and quickest solution.
options.cost_hint: Usually no extra cost if the same room type is available.

options.title: Ask Hotel for Assistance with Luggage and Transfers
options.detail: If a ground floor room is not available, request hotel staff to help Priya and her luggage up and down the stairs as needed. This is less ideal and may not be safe for frequent movement, but can be a temporary solution.
options.cost_hint: May be free or involve a small tip for staff assistance.

options.title: Transfer to a Nearby Accessible Hotel
options.detail: If the hotel cannot provide a suitable room, ask for help finding a nearby accessible hotel and request a refund or transfer. Contact your travel agent or booking platform for urgent support.
options.cost_hint: May involve extra cost if the new hotel is more expensive; some costs may be refunded by the original hotel.

events.text: The best immediate options are: request a ground floor room, ask the hotel for help with luggage and transfers, or move to a nearby hotel with step-free access. Would you like help drafting a message to the hotel, or do you want suggestions for accessible hotels nearby?
